description_en: Creates access permissions for a private gateway to allow specified IP address segments to access the gateway
description_zh: 创建私有网关的访问权限，添加权限的IP段可以访问网关
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-acl-policy --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --acl-policy-list Entry=10.23.XX.XX/32 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAclPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. For more information about how to obtain the private gateway ID, see the private_gateway_id field in the response of the ListResources operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见ListResources接口返回结果中的private_gateway_id字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information about how to obtain the VPC ID, see DescribeVpcs
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见DescribeVpcs
parameters.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The description of the IP address segment that is allowed to access the VPC
fields.help_zh: 专有网络可访问IP段备注
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en: The IP address segment that is allowed to access the VPC
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of IP address segments that are allowed to access the VPC
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络可访问IP段白名单列表
parameters.name: acl_policy_list

GatewayId.description_en: The ID of the private gateway

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
Message.example: Successfully add acl policy for gateway
